name: CSO_FAVORITE_FOLLOW
description: This table stores the user created favorite and follows.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: Record ID for this record.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: Party ID for the user creating this record.

columns.name: FAVORITE_FLAG
columns.description: Favorite preference for the user for this record.

columns.name: FOLLOW_FLAG
columns.description: Follow preference of the user for this record.

columns.name: FAVORITE_TYPE
columns.description: Obsolete: Type of favorite record 1=Article, 0=Filter Set.

columns.name: FAVORITE_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: Identifier for this record. Stores answer id if not defaulted to FILTERSET.

columns.name: LOCALE_ID
columns.description: Locale Id for this record.

columns.name: FILTERSET_DISPLAY_NAME
columns.description: Display name for the filter set.

columns.name: FILTER_API_CALL
columns.description: Obsolete: API Call that needs to be made for this filterset.

columns.name: FILTER_API_PARAMS
columns.description: Obsolete: API Parameters to be passed in API call.

columns.name: FILTER_API_PAYLOAD
columns.description: API Payload to be passed.

columns.name: FILTER_API_HEADER
columns.description: Obsolete: Header details to be passed in request.

columns.name: DEFAULT_FILTER_FLAG
columns.description: Default flag for filterset records. Y=Default, N=Not Default.

columns.name: APP_METADATA_REF
columns.description: UI APP reference. Mapped with cso_favorite_app_metadata.

columns.name: LAST_NOTIFICATION_DATE
columns.description: Last notification date for this user and document or filterset.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
